The Indigenous Peoples of these three villages, the Yup’ik (Newtok) and Iñupiat (Kivalina, Shishmaref), have lived on these territories from time immemorial. Upon colonization, first by Russia and then The United States (US), these Indigenous communities were brought into a settler colonial system where their bodies, lands, and ways of life were the target of appropriation and assimilation (Wolfe, 2006).
